title: Dreaming in Cosmic Swirls
description: A bearded man with closed eyes sleeps peacefully in an ornate wooden bed with pink pillows, surrounded by red poppies. His blanket transforms into a vibrant, swirling cosmic dreamscape featuring a giant stylized eye that contains a miniature version of the sleeping man within its pupil.
prompt: A bearded man sleeping peacefully in a wooden bed with pink pillows, red poppies scattered on the blanket and around him. His blanket morphs into a flowing psychedelic cosmic river of swirls and stars that becomes a giant stylized eye filled with galaxies and nebulae. Inside the eye's pupil is a tiny version of the same sleeping man, vibrant surreal dream sequence, intricate details, rich textures
